---
title: "Lab"
page-layout: custom
format:
  html:
    theme: none
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
              .lab-lead{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 56px}
              .lab-lead .lede{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:23px;line-height:1.55;
                color:var(--ink-2);margin:24px 0;
              }
              .lab-lead .lede em{color:var(--sage);font-style:italic}
              .lab-lead .note{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;
                color:var(--ink-3);background:var(--cream-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);
                padding:12px 16px;border-radius:6px;line-height:1.55;
              }
          
              .lab-demo{
                max-width:1080px;margin:80px auto 0;padding:0 56px;
              }
              .lab-demo .head{
                display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:32px;align-items:end;
                padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);
              }
              .lab-demo .head .num{
                font-family:'Cookie',cursive;font-size:96px;color:var(--sage);line-height:.8;
              }
              .lab-demo .head h2{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:42px;
                margin:0;color:var(--ink);
              }
              .lab-demo .head .kicker{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:8px;
              }
              .lab-demo .head .status{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--terracotta);font-weight:500;
                border:1px solid rgba(179,74,58,.4);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;
              }
          
              .lab-grid{
                display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:48px;margin-top:40px;align-items:start;
              }
              .lab-grid .copy h3{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;
                font-size:22px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--ink);
              }
              .lab-grid .copy p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-2)}
          
              .lab-controls{
                background:var(--cream-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px;
                padding:24px 26px;
              }
              .lab-controls h3{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);margin:0 0 14px;font-weight:500;
              }
              .lab-controls .control{
                padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-2);
                display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px 24px;align-items:center;
              }
              .lab-controls .control:first-of-type{border-top:none}
              .lab-controls .control .label{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:17px;font-style:italic;color:var(--ink);
              }
              .lab-controls .control .hint{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink-3);
                grid-column:1/-1;letter-spacing:.02em;
              }
              .lab-controls .control input[type="range"]{
                grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;accent-color:var(--sage);
              }
              .lab-controls .control .val{
                font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--sage);
                padding:2px 8px;background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:999px;
              }
          
              .lab-plot{
                margin-top:32px;background:var(--cream-2);border:1px solid var(--rule);
                border-radius:6px;padding:24px;
              }
              .lab-plot .title{
                display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px;
              }
              .lab-plot .title h4{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:500;
                font-size:20px;margin:0;color:var(--ink);
              }
              .lab-plot .title .skill{
                font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;color:var(--sage);
              }
              .lab-plot svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
              .lab-plot .legend{
                margin-top:10px;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;
                letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink-3);display:flex;gap:18px;
              }
              .lab-plot .legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
              .lab-plot .legend .sw{width:14px;height:2px;background:var(--ink)}
              .lab-plot .legend .sw.fc{background:var(--terracotta);height:0;border-top:2px dashed var(--terracotta)}
          
              .lab-meta{
                margin-top:24px;
                display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:24px;
              }
              .lab-meta .m{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);
              }
              .lab-meta .m b{
                display:block;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-style:italic;
                font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;
                margin-top:2px;font-weight:500;
              }
          
              .lab-back{
                max-width:1080px;margin:80px auto 0;padding:32px 56px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);
              }
              .lab-back h2{
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:28px;
                margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--ink);
              }
              .lab-back .sub{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.18em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:500;
              }
              .lab-back ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
              .lab-back ul li{
                padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-2);
                display:grid;grid-template-columns:140px 1fr;gap:18px;
                font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink-2);
              }
              .lab-back ul li:first-child{border-top:none}
              .lab-back ul li .tag{
                font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;
                text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sage);font-weight:500;padding-top:3px;
              }
          
              @media (max-width:900px){
                .lab-lead,.lab-demo,.lab-back{padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px}
                .lab-demo,.lab-back{margin-top:48px}
                .lab-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
                .lab-meta{grid-template-columns:1fr}
                .lab-demo .head{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
                .lab-back ul li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px}
              }
          </style>

```{=html}
<script>document.body.dataset.page='lab';document.body.dataset.screenLabel='04 Lab';</script>

<main>
<div class="page-narrow" style="text-align:center">
<h1 class="page-title">Lab</h1>
<div class="page-sub">small things you can poke at</div>
</div>

<div class="lab-lead">
<p class="lede">
A small workshop of <em>interactive demos</em>. Each one drops you straight into a method
I use, on a public dataset, with controls that change the numbers in real time. Ships
with one item now. Grows from there.
</p>
<p class="note">
<b style="color:var(--ink)">Build status.</b> The Lab page is new with this redesign.
The first demo (EDM forecasting) is in design here, not yet wired to a live engine.
The plot below uses placeholder data so the layout and interaction model can be
reviewed before the maths goes in.
</p>
</div>

<!-- Demo 1 -->
<section class="lab-demo" data-screen-label="04a EDM demo">
<div class="head">
<div class="num">i</div>
<div>
<div class="kicker">demo one</div>
<h2>EDM forecasting on a public time series</h2>
</div>
<div class="status">In design</div>
</div>

<div class="lab-grid">
<div class="copy">
<h3>What it is</h3>
<p>
Empirical Dynamic Modelling reconstructs the underlying state space of a system
from a single observed time series. It does not assume a parametric model. That
makes it useful for ecological data, where the dynamics are often nonlinear and
the right functional form is rarely obvious in advance.
</p>
<h3>What you get to do</h3>
<p>
Pick a forecast horizon, an embedding dimension, and a train / test split.
Watch the forecast track or fail to track the held out portion of the series,
and read the skill metric update underneath.
</p>
</div>

<aside class="lab-controls" aria-label="EDM forecast controls">
<h3>controls</h3>
<div class="control">
<span class="label">Forecast horizon</span>
<span class="val" id="v-h">6 steps</span>
<input type="range" min="1" max="24" value="6" id="c-h" aria-label="Forecast horizon" />
<span class="hint">how far ahead the model predicts</span>
</div>
<div class="control">
<span class="label">Embedding dimension</span>
<span class="val" id="v-e">3</span>
<input type="range" min="2" max="10" value="3" id="c-e" aria-label="Embedding dimension" />
<span class="hint">number of lags used to reconstruct the attractor</span>
</div>
<div class="control">
<span class="label">Train / test split</span>
<span class="val" id="v-s">70 / 30</span>
<input type="range" min="50" max="90" value="70" id="c-s" aria-label="Train fraction" />
<span class="hint">proportion of the series used to fit</span>
</div>
</aside>
</div>

</div>

<span data-mount="foot"></span>

<script>
// Tiny reactive demo: regenerate a synthetic ecological-looking series + forecast
// when the user moves any slider. Pure decoration; not real EDM.
(function () {
const W = 800, H = 240, N = 96;
const obs = document.getElementById('lab-obs');
const fc  = document.getElementById('lab-fc');
const div = document.getElementById('lab-div');
const divL= document.getElementById('lab-div-l');
const cH = document.getElementById('c-h'), vH = document.getElementById('v-h');
const cE = document.getElementById('c-e'), vE = document.getElementById('v-e');
const cS = document.getElementById('c-s'), vS = document.getElementById('v-s');
const vRho = document.getElementById('v-rho');

// Deterministic-ish "ecological" series: damped wobble + noise.
function genSeries(n, seed) {
const xs = [];
let r = seed;
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
r = (r * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
const noise = (r / 233280 - 0.5) * 0.35;
const v = 0.55
+ 0.30 * Math.sin(i * 0.32)
+ 0.15 * Math.sin(i * 0.11 + 1.3)
+ 0.10 * Math.cos(i * 0.55 + 0.7)
+ noise * 0.5;
xs.push(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)));
}
return xs;
}
const series = genSeries(N, 7);

function pathFor(arr, x0, x1) {
const n = arr.length;
let d = '';
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
const x = x0 + (i / (n - 1)) * (x1 - x0);
const y = 220 - arr[i] * 180;
d += (i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L') + x.toFixed(1) + ',' + y.toFixed(1) + ' ';
}
return d;
}

function update() {
const horizon = +cH.value;          // 1..24
const embed   = +cE.value;           // 2..10
const split   = +cS.value;           // 50..90 percent train
vH.textContent = horizon + ' steps';
vE.textContent = embed;
vS.textContent = split + ' / ' + (100 - split);

const cut = Math.round(N * split / 100);
const xCut = (cut / (N - 1)) * W;
div.setAttribute('x1', xCut);
div.setAttribute('x2', xCut);
divL.setAttribute('x', xCut + 8);

// Observed = full series, but we only draw up to test region with smooth path.
obs.setAttribute('d', pathFor(series, 0, W));

// Forecast = noisy copy of test segment, "skill" depends on horizon + embed.
const skill = Math.max(0.05, Math.min(0.96,
0.95 - 0.018 * (horizon - 1) - 0.04 * Math.abs(embed - 4) - (1 - split / 100) * 0.6
));
const tail = series.slice(cut);
const noisy = tail.map((v, i) => {
const drift = (1 - skill) * 0.5 * Math.sin(i * 0.7 + embed);
return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v + drift + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (1 - skill) * 0.3));
});
fc.setAttribute('d', pathFor(noisy, xCut, W));

vRho.textContent = skill.toFixed(2);
}
[cH, cE, cS].forEach(el => el.addEventListener('input', update));
update();
})();
</script>
```
